'''Tavan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] sentry who served in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] and was stationed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was sent to recover research supplies by [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Garus]] after the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] using them to research the [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos]] went mad, but found them in possession of [[Imperial soldier]]s who went berserk, who also held the code cylinders required to open the multilocks on the crates. Not helping the matter was his soldiers' reluctance to shoot their former comrades, and the group ultimately failed to recapture the cylinders and were wiped out. Through a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] sent to Garus, an acolyte became aware of and managed to complete Tavon's mission.<ref name="Supplies" />
